description: This file defines the HardwareAdapter class for managing hardware device interactions, including flashing, serial communication, and script execution, within a testing harness environment.

classes.name: HardwareAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for real hardware device management, including flashing, serial communication, and script execution.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HardwareAdapter with device configuration.

methods.name: generate_command
methods.description: Generates the command to flash the device.

methods.name: _prepare_runner_args
methods.description: Prepares additional arguments for the flash command based on the runner and device ID.

methods.name: _flash_and_run
methods.description: Performs flashing of the device and handles post-flash scripts and logging.

methods.name: _connect_device
methods.description: Establishes serial connection to the device, possibly via a PTY.

methods.name: _open_serial_pty
methods.description: Opens a pseudo-terminal pair for serial communication.

methods.name: is_device_running
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently running.

methods.name: is_device_connected
methods.description: Checks if the device is connected via serial.

methods.name: _read_device_output
methods.description: Reads output from the device serial connection.

methods.name: _readline_serial
methods.description: Reads a line from serial connection without blocking.

methods.name: _readline_from_serial_buffer
methods.description: Extracts a line from the internal serial buffer.

methods.name: _write_to_device
methods.description: Writes data to the device serial connection.

methods.name: _clear_internal_resources
methods.description: Clears internal resources like serial connections and buffers.

methods.name: _run_custom_script
methods.description: Executes a custom script with timeout handling.
